description: This file implements a web-based search interface for Kconfig options, including rendering search results, handling user input, and loading a JSON database of Kconfig entries.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message in the results area.

methods.name: showProgress
methods.description: Displays a progress message during database loading.

methods.name: renderKconfigPropLiteral
methods.description: Renders a literal property of a Kconfig entry.

methods.name: renderKconfigPropList
methods.description: Renders a list property of a Kconfig entry.

methods.name: renderKconfigDefaults
methods.description: Renders default values for a Kconfig entry, including toggle for additional defaults.

methods.name: renderKconfigEntry
methods.description: Renders a complete Kconfig entry as HTML.

methods.name: doSearch
methods.description: Performs a search based on user input and updates the display.

methods.name: doSearchFromURL
methods.description: Performs a search based on URL hash.

methods.name: setupKconfigSearch
methods.description: Initializes the search interface, loads database, and sets event listeners.
